77: 			return;
78: 		}
79: 		
80: 		boolean suppressBaseMethods = annotation.getInstance().suppressBaseMethods();
81: 		
82: 		List<Object> extensionProviders = annotation.getActualExpressions("value");
83: 		if (extensionProviders.isEmpty()) {
84: 			annotationNode.addError(String.format("@%s has no effect since no extension types were specified.", ExtensionMethod.class.getName()));
85: 			return;
86: 		}

88: 		if (extensions.isEmpty()) return;
